scope_limits: Reconciliation only applies when at least one find_spray_window call is recorded in tool_logger.calls; the function returns recommendations_data unchanged if there are no spray calls (runner.py:62-64), so turns lacking such a call leave parsed recommendations unreconciled.

If find_spray_window's raw result lacks a parseable dict with 'defer_cause', the reconciler returns the data unchanged (runner.py:66-69).
The advisor question path (run_advisor_question) persists nothing and is out of scope for this contract.
No claim is made here about whether the override is sufficient or correct in all runtime cases; this contract records the declared guard and its wiring only.
